title: Arcane Dust
text: Some materials release arcane dust during analysis: the residue of arcane vibrations.

Use Arcane Dust on an amethyst, dream, spatial or deflection crystal matrix to advance every eligible cluster by one stage. Empty or water-source faces sprout small buds. Even a single growable face triggers growth and consumes 1 dust. Nothing is consumed only when all six faces are blocked or mature. Mature clusters, other crystal families and obstructed faces are unaffected.
